players.name: Tyrese Haliburton
players.inj_note: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Paul George
players.inj_note: George will be rested Monday against Houston.

players.name: Jalen Johnson
players.inj_note: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game versus Indiana.

players.name: Kyrie Irving
players.inj_note: Irving (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Kings.

players.name: Andrew Nembhard
players.inj_note: Nembhard (cervical strain) is out for Monday's game against Atlanta.

players.name: Paolo Banchero
players.inj_note: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Anthony Black
players.inj_note: Black will be rested Monday against the Wizards.

players.name: Dejounte Murray
players.inj_note: Murray (personal) is out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies.

players.name: Kawhi Leonard
players.inj_note: Leonard (knee) is expected to be sidelined for at least three to four weeks, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

players.name: Anthony Edwards
players.inj_note: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

players.name: Pascal Siakam
players.inj_note: Siakam will be rested against the Hawks on Monday.

players.name: Yves Missi
players.inj_note: Missi (knee) won't play in Saturday's game against Atlanta.

players.name: Alex Caruso
players.inj_note: Caruso (ankle) is expected to miss time due to an ankle sprain, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

players.name: Obi Toppin
players.inj_note: Toppin (back) will dress for Monday's game against  Hawks but will only play in an emergency, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

players.name: Peyton Watson
players.inj_note: Watson (hamstring) is out for Monday's game against the Thunder, Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

players.name: Derrick Jones Jr.
players.inj_note: Jones (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Raptors.

players.name: Jordan Goodwin
players.inj_note: Goodwin won't return to Monday's game against the Warriors due to a left calf injury, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports. He recorded four points (2-3 FG, 0-1 3Pt), two rebounds, two assists and one steal in 10 minutes before exiting.

players.name: Jalen Suggs
players.inj_note: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

players.name: Jalen Duren
players.inj_note: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

players.name: Rui Hachimura
players.inj_note: Hachimura (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Raptors.

players.name: Alex Sarr
players.inj_note: Sarr (knee) is out for Monday's game against Orlando.

players.name: Chet Holmgren
players.inj_note: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

players.name: Terrence Shannon Jr.
players.inj_note: Shannon (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bucks, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Ja Morant
players.inj_note: Morant has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and is expected to miss four weeks, Portland announced Friday.

players.name: Brandon Williams
players.inj_note: Williams (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Suns.

players.name: Ivica Zubac
players.inj_note: Zubac (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hawks.

players.name: Aaron Nesmith
players.inj_note: Nesmith (rest) is sitting out Monday against Atlanta.

players.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
players.inj_note: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

players.name: Jordan Poole
players.inj_note: Poole (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies.

players.name: Egor Demin
players.inj_note: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

players.name: Kelly Oubre Jr.
players.inj_note: Oubre (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hawks.

players.name: Clint Capela
players.inj_note: Capela (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.

players.name: Jaylon Tyson
players.inj_note: Tyson (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Oklahoma City.

players.name: Jakob Poeltl
players.inj_note: Poeltl (shoulder) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Clippers, Zulfi Sheikh reports.

players.name: Keegan Murray
players.inj_note: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

players.name: Jock Landale
players.inj_note: Landale (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Indiana.

players.name: Max Christie
players.inj_note: Christie has been ruled out for the rest of Monday's game against the Kings due to a right hip injury, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports. He'll end the night with no points (0-5 FG, 0-5 3Pt), two rebounds and one steal in eight minutes.

players.name: Gui Santos
players.inj_note: Santos did not play in the second half of Sunday's 124-112 win over the Clippers due to a knee injury and will not play against the Suns on Monday, Danny Emerman of SFStandard.com reports.

players.name: Steven Adams
players.inj_note: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

players.name: Quinten Post
players.inj_note: Post (ankle) has been downgraded to out for Monday's game against the Pelicans.

players.name: Al Horford
players.inj_note: Horford will be rested Monday against the Suns.

players.name: Isaiah Joe
players.inj_note: Joe (hip) is out for Monday against the Hornets.

players.name: Larry Nance Jr.
players.inj_note: Nance (illness) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Hawks.

players.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
players.inj_note: Pippen (back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pelicans.

players.name: Anthony Gill
players.inj_note: Gill (back) is out for Monday's game against the Magic.

players.name: Sergio de Larrea
players.inj_note: Head coach Dusty May said Friday that de Larrea (knee) will be re-evaluated next week, Noah Weber of TheSmokingCuban.com reports.

players.name: Ben Sheppard
players.inj_note: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

players.name: Reece Beekman
players.inj_note: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

players.name: Jalen Williams
players.inj_note: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMahon of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Justin Champagnie
players.inj_note: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

players.name: Cason Wallace
players.inj_note: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
